title: mt_singpair_linear_pseudo: the iteration-38 confound check on iteration 37's velocity verdict (linear read-in at matched pseudo sector)

protocol.comparators: mt_singpair_linear / mt_singpair_nl_pseudo reports from iterations 36 (v1) and 37 (v1-lowre), re-aggregated at identical binning

dataset.v1_note: the v1 side reuses the production catalog of iteration 36 (840-case train split); only the new arm was trained this iteration, on both catalogs

notes.momentum_residual_note: ||nu~ lap u_pred - (u_pred . grad) u_pred - grad p_pred|| / ||(u_pred . grad) u_pred||: the strong-form steady N-S momentum residual of the model's own two output fields (float64 autograd, 32 interior queries, two cases per split); nu~ = 1/Re comes from the CASE, not the model -- the model never sees the governing equations, the metric does.  The normalizer is the prediction's own advection norm (no closed-form scale exists on a solver-labeled family); solver-exact fields score ~0
notes.divergence_residual_note: ||div u_pred|| L / ||u_pred||: the incompressibility strong form of the predicted velocity at the same subsample

joined.note: gap = arm minus nl_pseudo per-case mean per log-Re bin, seeds 17/29/43 pooled, eval_id + eval_unseen_Re; the join is between two separately trained catalogs (108- vs 840-case train splits) -- the GAP is the internally controlled measure on each side, absolute levels are not comparable across the join

iteration_38_confound_check.rule: REVISION outcome: bottom joined bin velocity gap (linear_pseudo minus nl_pseudo) <= 0.05 means the iteration-37 deficit was parity/capacity and its velocity reading is REVISED; STANDS outcome (falsifier of the revision): bottom gap >= 0.1 means the read-in-class reading stands, now unconfounded; between 0.05 and 0.1: partial closure
